searchSummary: Expanded primary-source survey through 2026-09-27. Inclusion-maximal independent set, maximum-cardinality independent set, lexicographically first MIS, and cardinality estimation have different outputs. Dynamic adversary, stream order and passes, LCA oracle and random seed, LOCAL elapsed/awake rounds, MPC local/global memory, graph classes and matrix/list access remain separated. Historical papers and incomparable bounds are visible; symbolic expressions are not converted to invented numeric regions. This is a substantial curated collection, not a claim of exhaustive coverage of every restricted graph family.

coverage.note: Centralized deterministic, oblivious randomized, adaptive incremental conditional hardness, and parallel batch update are separated. Dynamic distributed messages/rounds and vertex updates remain outside this survey.
Exact MIS in edge- and vertex-arrival streams; p-pass space tradeoff and lexicographically first MIS have separate tasks. Maximum independent set and approximate maximality are not conflated.
Not reviewed. The existing problem is maximal independent set; competitive maximum-independent-set optimization is a different task and must not be silently substituted.
Consistent membership with deterministic query-order-oblivious and randomized non-adaptive lower bounds in distinct scopes.
Classic randomized upper/lower, degree-sensitive bounds, deterministic network decomposition progression, and sleeping awake-complexity side measure. Specialized classes omitted.
Linear-memory general graph and strongly sublinear local-memory settings including arboricity and tree restrictions; component-stability conditional hardness retained separately.
Adjacency-list/array slices are separated below; inspect each oracle and output assumption.
Adjacency-matrix slices are separated below; inspect pair-query and output assumptions.
No scoped records assigned to this access category yet.
New column requested by the user; stochastic submodels and theorem figures await scoped review. Random-order online results are not automatically transferred here.
